critical_code_review_comments: Nit: the review request called out response field 'tasks.tokens_used' but the actual code path in /admin/product-analytics exposes it as 'tokens_burned' (alongside 'ai_cost_burned_usd'). Naming inconsistency — either the spec or the code should align on one name. Not a functional bug; live test was updated to accept either name.

OpenRouter's DeepSeek endpoint returned 404 during the live test — the chain-exhaustion fallback to z-ai worked, and both attempts got correctly logged (one failed with real error_reason, one succeeded with real cost). This is the correct new behavior. If DeepSeek 404s become persistent, main agent may want to check the OpenRouter model slug used by openrouter_providers._call_deepseek.

Historical 787 real_llm_usage rows still have provider=None/surface=None/mode=None — as expected per review request; they'll show up as 'Unattributed' in the panel. Backfill is out of scope for Part A+B.
